items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And there was a band out in Chicago they called Dick Jergen... let's use Dick Jurgens's drummer with the bass

ctx.x: And I said, give me a spot right in front of Basie. I'd fit the spots in, and they'd say, yeah, the girls get what they want. I had One O'Clock Jump written, note for note, and one of the girls, they had her solo down just like Basie was playing, that's what they did. And that made the novelty good, because when they come on and hear Basie, that just knocked the guys out to play just exactly what Basie was playing.
It was a gag, you know? And there was a band out in Chicago they called Dick Jergen. That was --
